breadcrumbs.name: Google Review NFC Card Setup Guide

summary: This guide helps businesses set up Google review NFC cards with fewer avoidable failures by focusing on the live review link, redirect control, phone testing and a reliable QR fallback.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
A simple review-link workflow usually works better than a complicated NFC payload.

faq.question: What should be set up first on a Google review NFC card?
faq.answer: The first setup priority is the live review destination and who controls it, because every later design, encoding and rollout choice depends on that link working reliably.

faq.question: Why is QR fallback still important on an NFC review card?
faq.answer: QR fallback keeps the review prompt usable when a customer does not tap correctly, NFC is disabled or the phone behavior is inconsistent enough to need another path.
